description: Sketch types, signatures, and module structure before code, then stay in the loop while implementation fills in. The output is the shape of the code, not a task plan. Use on request ("architect this", "design this before coding") or as a step of a larger workflow, for non-trivial work where jumping to code would lock in the wrong shape. For a written plan of scope, phases and risks, use the `plan-change` skill.
